title: The Lighter Brief
overview: A pretty mixed bag this time, with a lot of fun stuff in it. In politics, Israel's president handed Netanyahu's main rival the first shot at forming a government, and President Trump publicly offered the UFC's Dana White the press secretary job. Closer to the ground, Charlotte honored its veterans, an English councillor caught a stone thief with an AirTag, and Atlanta is getting a new OutKast exhibit.

stories.headline: Netanyahu's rival gets first shot at forming Israel's next government
stories.summary: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has asked Gadi Eisenkot, leader of the centrist Yashar party, to try to build a governing coalition after the Oct. 27 election. Netanyahu's Likud won the most seats, but his coalition fell short of a majority. Reporters call it the closest Netanyahu has come to losing power since 2021, though deep divisions could still stop a new government from forming.
key_facts: Likud won 27 seats and Yashar won 21. A majority takes 61 of the Knesset's 120 seats.
Netanyahu's coalition won 53 seats.
Eisenkot has 28 days to form a coalition, with a possible 14-day extension.
Netanyahu stays on as caretaker prime minister in the meantime.
stories.why: If Eisenkot can't form a government, another lawmaker gets a turn, and Israel could end up heading to another election.

stories.headline: Reggae label boss Chris Chin honored in New York
stories.summary: Chris Chin, CEO of VP Records, received the Community Award at the Jamaican American Law Enforcement Organization's fourth annual gala. He was recognized for his long work preserving and spreading Jamaican culture through music.
key_facts: The gala was held Nov. 6 at Floral Terrace in Floral Park, New York.
VP Records is described as the world's largest independent reggae and dancehall label.
Christopher Martin performed to close the evening.
stories.why: It's a warm night of recognition, summed up by Chin's line that "service keeps the doors open for others."

links.title: VP Records CEO honoured at JAMLEO Awards Gala

stories.headline: Charlotte kicks off Veterans Week with a parade and festival
stories.summary: More than 2,000 people turned out in Uptown Charlotte on Saturday for the annual Salute to Veterans Parade, with high school bands and scouts taking part. A festival at Romare Bearden Park featured veteran-owned businesses, employer resource groups, food and activities.
key_facts: Veterans Day is Wednesday.
More than 2,000 people attended the parade.
The parade opens a week of honors events in the city.
stories.why: It's a big community thank-you, and it gave veteran-owned businesses a spotlight too.

stories.headline: Crash closed I-485 Outer near Rocky River Road
stories.summary: A crash between a semi truck and a car closed all lanes of I-485 Outer near exit 36 in northeast Charlotte on Saturday afternoon. Traffic backed up for miles as crews waited for tow trucks.
key_facts: The crash was reported around 4:30 p.m.
One person was taken to the hospital with minor injuries.
Traffic was moving through the shoulder.
stories.why: If you're driving through University City, check traffic and plan an alternate route if needed.

stories.headline: Manning Cup quarterfinal lineup is set
stories.summary: Jamaica College, Mona High and Wolmer's Boys grabbed the last three spots in the ISSA Manning Cup quarterfinals. Defending champions Excelsior came from behind to beat St George's College 2-1 and topped their zone.
key_facts: Mona High beat St Catherine High 4-0, and STATHS beat St Jago High 5-0.
Kingston College beat Calabar 1-0 to top Zone 2.
Group A is Excelsior, Eltham, Wolmer's Boys and Calabar.
Group B is KC, STATHS, Mona and JC.
stories.why: Jamaica's schoolboy football is heading into its exciting stretch.

stories.headline: Trump publicly offers UFC's Dana White the press secretary job
stories.summary: In a Truth Social post, President Trump offered UFC chief Dana White the White House press secretary role, which has been vacant since mid-October. White then posted a photo of himself at the briefing room lectern captioned "On to the next chapter." Later he said, "I got a lot of jobs already."
key_facts: The previous press secretary, Katie Zacharia, left after about five days in October.
White says he's meeting Trump in Washington on Monday.
CNN cited a source saying White had declined.
White already runs the UFC, Power Slap and the new Zuffa Boxing, and sits on Meta's board.
disputed: It's unclear whether the offer was meant seriously.
It's also unclear whether White's lectern post was tongue-in-cheek.
White hasn't confirmed either way. A CNN source says he declined, but that isn't official.
stories.why: It's an unusual public job offer for a high-profile White House role, and Monday's meeting may clear things up.

stories.headline: Man arrested at LeBron James' LA home
stories.summary: Los Angeles police arrested a man on suspicion of felony stalking after responding to a possible burglary call at LeBron James' home Friday night. James was in Cleveland at the time, playing with the Philadelphia 76ers.
key_facts: Officers responded around 9:40 p.m. on Nov. 6.
LAPD confirmed the arrest but hasn't named the suspect.
James joined the 76ers in July for his 24th NBA season.
disputed: Confirmed: an arrest on suspicion of felony stalking.
Unclear: police haven't described what the man did or whether there was any threat.
He is only accused at this point, not charged or convicted as far as reported.
stories.why: James was away and no one was reported hurt.

links.title: Man Arrested For Felony Stalking At LeBron James’ Los Angeles Home

stories.headline: Atlanta's Trap Music Museum opens an OutKast exhibit
stories.summary: The Trap Music Museum is unveiling a new exhibit celebrating OutKast, the duo of Andre 3000 and Big Boi. It looks at their impact on music, art, fashion and Southern culture.
key_facts: The opening celebration is Monday, Nov. 9, from 8 p.m. to midnight at 630 Travis Street NW.
The free RSVP list is already full, and a small batch of general tickets is expected.
Speakerboxxx/The Love Below won the Grammy for Album of the Year.
stories.why: Atlanta gets to celebrate one of its legendary groups at home, and the exhibit stays open after opening night.

links.title: Trap Music Museum Opens New OutKast Exhibit In Atlanta
